every-requirement-testable.reason: RE-EVALUATED 2026-08-24 after the second decomposition, and the re-evaluation is the point: the previous attestation was true of a 14-requirement plan and this one is not that plan. All 14 original active requirements still state observable conditions. The five application-shell requirements REQ-0016..REQ-0020 are each testable as written: current-stage display is checkable against the derived stage, MDX rendering and its component bound are checkable by rendering a document that references a component outside the permitted set, external refresh is checkable by writing a file from outside the application, the typed write path is checkable by asserting no other write path exists, and installability is checkable on a clean machine. ⚠️ Testable is not the same as SPECIFIED: four of the five depend on an open question (QST-0017..QST-0021), and this criterion asks whether a requirement can be tested, not whether the answer it will be tested against has been chosen yet.
